title: revert react-native dependency updates
author: jpmunz
body:
Reverting dependabot updates to `src/react-native-app`, this was generated by going back to the first commit before the dependabot PRs and then re-installing to get a new lock file:
```
git checkout 19cbfeaca81d6c1a728183386721b98c52001b81 package.json
npm install
```
